reading: emit's cost structure on host DANIELDILLBERG. Court A (deterministic): 674760 wall + 694648 floor textured px, 677350 divides, 4108224 tile reads, working set 60176 floor / 65529 wall distinct texels (of 65536), and 590 permille of adjacent floor texels within a cache line. Court B (host ablation, p99 us): addr 4070 -> lookup 5141 -> full 6052, emit 4973; the increments are lookup-addr 1071 (tile fetch), full-lookup 911 (map/assembly). These are INCREMENTAL wall-clock attribution under controlled ablation, NOT pure resource costs: cache/branch/scheduling make the subtraction non-additive and the experiment has no architectural counters. The largest increment is 'tile fetch (lookup - addr)'; the promotion table (the reader's, from the preregistration) says a dominant lookup increment or pathological locality LOCKs a data-layout/locality court, a dominant address increment the arithmetic path, a dominant write the framebuffer path, and disagreement or no dominance DEFERs. probe VERIFY is byte-identical to emit (the apparatus is a subset of the certified path); FULL carries a small black_box anchor tax vs emit (full-emit 1079 us at p99). This is EMIT-level only, never the whole render, and NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented absolute
